core_principles: Trust through Clarity: No hidden elements, clear hierarchy.
Growth & Vision: Emerald greens symbolize growth; the design feels expansive.
Tactile Precision: Inputs and buttons feel physical and responsive.

scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500 font-bold mb-2 block

button.base: h-12 px-8 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all duration-300 transform active:scale-95
button.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20 hover:shadow-emerald-600/40 hover:-translate-y-0.5
button.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:border-zinc-300

input.field: h-12 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-500/10 transition-all duration-200 font-medium
input.label_floating: absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400 pointer-events-none transition-all duration-200 group-focus-within:-translate-y-[28px] group-focus-within:text-xs group-focus-within:text-emerald-600 bg-white px-1

card.glass: rounded-2xl bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl p-8

visual_enhancers.texture: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text-zinc-500 is only used on white backgrounds. Use text-zinc-400 for placeholders only.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: `npm install framer-motion` or `yarn add framer-motion` for the animations.
LAYOUT: Use a min-h-screen flex col md:grid md:grid-cols-12 overflow-hidden.
LEFT PANEL (Cols 1-5): Flex col justify-center p-8 md:p-12 relative z-10 bg-zinc-50.
RIGHT PANEL (Cols 6-12): Relative hidden md:flex flex-col justify-center items-center bg-emerald-950 overflow-hidden.
RIGHT PANEL BACKGROUND: Apply the 'background_texture' image with `mix-blend-overlay` and opacity-20. Add the SVG noise texture on top.
RIGHT PANEL CONTENT: Create a 'Glass Stack' of features. Use the provided glass_card style. Rotate cards slightly for a 'tossed' look.
LOGO: Place the logo at the top left of the Left Panel (w-32).
FORM: Center the form vertically in the Left Panel. Max width 420px.
INPUTS: Use the 'Floating Label' style defined in components.input.
TESTING: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., 'login-email-input', 'login-submit-button').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for dark solid colors.
Avoid centering text in the main form; keep it left-aligned for readability.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for the Employee ID field to distinguish it from regular text.
Ensure the Google Login button is styled as 'Secondary' but with the Google icon.
Use `lucide-react` for icons (Lock, User, Check, Eye, EyeOff).
